overview_description.description:
Clerky's software and templates help make sure you end up with the same level of quality that you would get from a top Silicon Valley law firm.

We're uniquely able to do this because we are run by startup attorneys and paralegals with extensive experience from top startup law firms. We've seen all the issues that come up in legal due diligence, and work hard to help our customers avoid them.

We don't just blindly mimic the output of attorneys though. There are many non‑obvious issues with moving legal paperwork online. Our deep experience enables us to recognize issues and do the necessary legal research. We do a tremendous amount of research - more than what a typical startup attorney would ever do.

Every time you use Clerky, you benefit from our obsession for quality. Our deep legal expertise and extensive legal research are built directly into our software and templates.

about_short_description.short_description: Clerky makes it easy for startups and their attorneys to get legal paperwork done safely.

product.name: Incorporation
product.description: Service to incorporate startups as Delaware C corporations, including expedited filing and registered agent services.

product.name: Post-Incorporation Setup
product.description: Service to complete essential corporate setup tasks like issuing stock, electing directors, appointing officers, and adopting bylaws.

product.name: Fundraising Legal Documentation
product.description: Tools to manage startup fundraising paperwork including board consents, safes, convertible notes, and investor agreements.

product.name: Hiring Legal Paperwork
product.description: Templates and tools for preparing legal documents for hiring employees, consultants, and advisors, including offer letters and confidentiality agreements.

product.name: Equity Compensation Management
product.description: Service to issue and manage equity compensation such as restricted stock and stock options, including early exercisable options and 83(b) election support.

product.name: Maintenance Services
product.description: Services to update corporate records such as changing officers, directors, company name, or increasing authorized shares.
